messages:
maria_support: Hi team, ACME (acct: acme-inc) filed a GDPR DPA erasure request but our deletion job is failing for their Dedicated tenant. Customer reports request succeeded in portal but objects still appear in storage. Error seen in task logs: `kms:AccessDenied` when attempting to rewrap/delete CEK. Can someone help triage?
customer_acme_it: we clicked 'request deletion' in the console at ~17:05 UTC. got a success toast, but data still searchable via embeddings API for ~20 minutes. screenshots attached.
maria_support: repro log snippet from job runner: ```2026-03-10T17:06:02Z ERROR deletion-job tenant=acme err="kms:AccessDenied: Caller is not authorized to use key" key_id=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789:key/abcd-efgh```
maria_support: note: this is the private/dedicated flow (VPC) for acme, using customer-managed KMS key via the HSM connector we set up last year.
josh_sre: thanks — first guess is IAM role mismatch on the dedicated worker that runs the erasure job. Can you paste the worker pod env (masked) and the role arn it's using?
maria_support: pasted: `WORKER_ROLE_ARN=arn:aws:iam::987654321:role/rw-deletion-worker-acme` and the deletion job runs on the dedicated pool labeled `dedicated-acme-1`.
liam_security: tagging in security. If KMS access is failing we can't produce a clean audit trail; need to avoid returning partial success to customer. @maria_support please pause any automated follow-ups and mark the DPA request P0.
audit-bot: [ticket created] INC-2345: ACME GDPR erasure failure - missing KMS decrypt perms (assigned: josh_sre, liam_security)
josh_sre: checking KMS key policy — looks like the key is restricted to principals in acct 123456789, but the worker role is in our infra acct 987654321. That explains AccessDenied. Possible fixes: (1) add cross-account role principal to key policy (2) run deletion via a proxy role in key's account.
maria_support: ACME says they never changed key policy. They expect us to handle deletions as part of Dedicated agreement. Any quick mitigation so customer doesn't escalate?
liam_security: short term: we can create a temporary cross-account grant that allows `kms:Decrypt` for the worker role for 1 hour and rerun the job. Need approval from legal/ops. Long term: update onboarding doc to include required key policy snippet and automatic verification.
eva_sales: FYI I'm on the call with ACME execs at 19:00 UTC. They need an ETA and evidence that data will be erased. We should avoid saying 'success' until we have logs.
josh_sre: I can create the one-hour grant now. @liam_security please confirm. After grant we should rerun the deletion job and capture: (a) audit logs from KMS (CloudTrail entries) (b) deletion job stdout + TRACE with job id, (c) storage verify step (list object metadata).
liam_security: approved for emergency grant. Make sure to add `aws:RequestTag/erasure_ticket=INC-2345` so we can filter. Also record justification in the audit ticket.
josh_sre: grant created: `GrantId=gr-0a1b2c3d` TTL=1h. Re-running deletion now.
maria_support: running delete-repro command (internal): ```./scripts/run-erasure --tenant acme --job-id inc-2345 --verify true```
maria_support: after rerun: job completed with exit 0, storage verify shows 0 objects in `acme/private/active`, KMS CloudTrail shows `Decrypt` by role arn:987654321 at 2026-03-10T17:28:10Z (GrantId gr-0a1b2c3d).
audit-bot: [evidence uploaded] S3://redwood-audit/INC-2345/2026-03-10/ contains job-log.txt and cloudtrail.json
customer_acme_it: thanks — can we get a signed attestation or export proving deletion for our compliance team?
liam_security: we'll produce a deletion attestation PDF with the audit bundle (job log + cloudtrail) and a note on the temporary grant used. Legal will review wording. ETA: 24 hours.
eva_sales: I'll update the customer and block the exec call until we have the attestation. Please include timeline and next steps in the ticket.
maria_support: follow-ups: 1) update onboarding doc and infra verifier to assert key policy includes `Principal` for our deletion role or to set up a persistent cross-account role. 2) create runbook for emergency grants with legal sign-off. 3) schedule postmortem to ensure we don't return success toast on frontend unless backend confirmation exists.
josh_sre: adding runbook checklist to INC-2345.
liam_security: note for postmortem: consider adding an automated key policy lint check at onboarding time; block Dedicated tenant onboarding until it passes.
maria_support: ACME notified. Closing loop once attestation uploaded. :white_check_mark:
